description: This file defines the 'TicTacToeViewModel' class, which manages the UI state for a TicTacToe game in an Android app. It handles persisting game state across configuration changes using SavedStateHandle, exposes methods for game interactions, and interacts with the GameEngine for game logic.

classes.name: TicTacToeViewModel
classes.description: Android ViewModel managing TicTacToe game UI state, persisting game state, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: UiState
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the UI state of the game, including board, current player, game over status, and winner info.

methods.name: onCellTapped
methods.description: Handles cell tap events, updates game state via GameEngine, and persists changes.

methods.name: onRestart
methods.description: Resets the game state for a new game session.

methods.name: markOutcomeShown
methods.description: Marks that the game outcome dialog has been shown.

methods.name: persistState
methods.description: Saves current game state into SavedStateHandle for persistence.

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restores game state from SavedStateHandle, providing default values if needed.
